CREATE TRIGGER TwrLinkiInsert ON CDN.TwrGrupy FOR INSERT AS
DECLARE @GidTyp SMALLINT DECLARE @GidFirma INT DECLARE @GidNumer INT DECLARE @GroTyp SMALLINT DECLARE @GroFirma INT DECLARE @GroNumer INT DECLARE @prevcount INT DECLARE @count INT
DECLARE TriggerCursor CURSOR FOR SELECT TWG_GIDTyp,TWG_GIDFirma,TWG_GIDNumer, TWG_GROTyp,TWG_GROFirma, TWG_GRONumer FROM INSERTED
OPEN TriggerCursor
FETCH NEXT FROM TriggerCursor INTO @GIDTyp,@GIDFirma,@GIDNumer,@GROTyp,@GROFirma,@GRONumer WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS = 0 BEGIN SET @prevcount=0 SET @count=-1
--tu z INSERTED oczywiscie CREATE TABLE #gronumery(GN INT,C INT) IF (@GIDTyp=-16) BEGIN
INSERT INTO #gronumery exec CDN.TwrRodzice @GroNumer
IF ((SELECT COUNT(*) FROM CDN.TwrLinki WHERE TWL_GRONumer=@GIDNumer)>0) BEGIN INSERT INTO CDN.TwrLinki (TWL_GIDTyp,TWL_GIDFirma,TWL_GIDNumer,TWL_GIDLp,TWL_GrOTyp,TWL_GrOFirma,TWL_GrONumer,TWL_GrOLp,TWL_Lisc,TWL_LiczbaPowtorzen,TWL_TStampDataMod) SELECT TWL_GIDTyp,TWL_GIDFirma,TWL_GIDNumer,TWL_GIDLp,-16,@GROFirma,GN,0,0,0,DATEDIFF(S,'19900101',GETDATE()) FROM (SELECT CDN.TwrLinki.TWL_GIDTyp,CDN.TwrLinki.TWL_GIDFirma,CDN.TwrLinki.TWL_GIDNumer,CDN.TwrLinki.TWL_GIDLp,GN,Linki.TWL_GRONumer AS GRO FROM CDN.TwrLinki RIGHT OUTER JOIN #gronumery ON TWL_GRONumer=@GIDNumer LEFT OUTER JOIN CDN.TwrLinki AS Linki ON Linki.TWL_GIDNumer=CDN.TwrLinki.TWL_GIDNumer AND Linki.TWL_GIDTyp=CDN.TwrLinki.TWL_GIDTyp AND Linki.TWL_GRONumer=GN) SelectWewn WHERE GRO IS NULL UPDATE CDN.TwrLinki --update dla wszystkich elementow nalezacych do grupy, ktora zostala wstawiona SET TWL_LiczbaPowtorzen=TWL_LiczbaPowtorzen+(SELECT (C) FROM #gronumery WHERE TWL_GRONumer=GN), TWL_TStampDataMod = DATEDIFF(S,'19900101',GETDATE()) WHERE TWL_GRONumer IN (SELECT GN FROM #gronumery) AND TWL_GIDNumer IN (SELECT TWL_GIDNumer FROM CDN.TwrLinki WHERE TWL_GRONumer=@GIDNumer) END TRUNCATE TABLE #gronumery --DROP TABLE #gronumery END INSERT INTO #gronumery exec CDN.TwrRodzice @GroNumer
INSERT INTO CDN.TwrLinki (TWL_GIDTyp,TWL_GIDFirma,TWL_GIDNumer,TWL_GIDLp,TWL_GrOTyp,TWL_GrOFirma,TWL_GrONumer,TWL_GrOLp,TWL_Lisc,TWL_LiczbaPowtorzen,TWL_TStampDataMod) SELECT @GIDTyp,@GIDFirma,@GIDNumer,0,-16,@GROFirma,GN,0,0,0,DATEDIFF( S , '19900101' , GETDATE()) FROM (SELECT @GIDNumer as GIDNr,GN,Linki.TWL_GRONumer as GRO FROM #gronumery LEFT OUTER JOIN CDN.TwrLinki AS Linki ON Linki.TWL_GIDNumer=@GIDNumer AND Linki.TWL_GIDTyp=@GIDTyp AND Linki.TWL_GRONumer=GN) SelectWewn WHERE GRO IS NULL --insert brakujacych rekordow to TwrLinki UPDATE CDN.TwrLinki -- dodanie odpowiedniej LP SET TWL_LiczbaPowtorzen=TWL_LiczbaPowtorzen+(SELECT c FROM #gronumery WHERE GN=TWL_GRONumer), TWL_TStampDataMod = DATEDIFF(S,'19900101',GETDATE()) WHERE TwL_GiDTyp = @GidTyp AND TwL_GiDFirma = @GidFirma AND TwL_GiDNumer = @GidNumer AND TwL_GroTyp = @GroTyp AND TwL_GroFirma = @GroFirma AND TwL_GroNumer IN (SELECT GN FROM #gronumery) UPDATE CDN.TwrLinki --ustawienie liscia SET TWL_Lisc=1,TWL_TStampDataMod = DATEDIFF(S,'19900101',GETDATE()) WHERE TwL_GiDTyp = @GidTyp AND TwL_GiDFirma = @GidFirma AND TwL_GiDNumer = @GidNumer AND TwL_GroTyp = @GroTyp AND TwL_GroFirma = @GroFirma AND TwL_GroNumer =@GROnumer
DROP TABLE #gronumery FETCH NEXT FROM TriggerCursor INTO @GIDTyp,@GIDFirma,@GIDNumer,@GROTyp,@GROFirma,@GRONumer END CLOSE TriggerCursor DEALLOCATE TriggerCursor

CREATE PROCEDURE Cdn.TwrRodzice @GIDNumer int AS BEGIN DECLARE @n INT DECLARE @prevcount INT DECLARE @count INT
SET @count=-1 SET @prevcount=0
CREATE TABLE #tmpnumery(GN INT,C INT) INSERT INTO #tmpnumery VALUES(@GIDNumer,1)
WHILE (@prevcount!=@count) --przechodzenie grafu wszerz, jezeli nic nie dodano konczymy BEGIN INSERT INTO #tmpnumery SELECT DISTINCT Twg_GRONumer,0 FROM CDN.TwrGrupy WHERE Twg_GIDNumer IN(SELECT GN FROM #tmpnumery) AND TWG_GIDTyp=-16 AND TWG_GIDNumer > 0 AND TWG_GRONumer NOT IN (SELECT GN FROM #tmpnumery) SET @prevcount=@count SET @count=(SELECT COUNT(*) FROM #tmpnumery) END SET @prevcount=0 SET @count=-1 WHILE (@prevcount!=@count) BEGIN DECLARE c CURSOR FOR SELECT GN FROM #tmpnumery OPEN c FETCH NEXT FROM c INTO @n FETCH NEXT FROM c INTO @n --pomijamy pierwszy rekord - dla niego C=1 IF (@count=-1) SET @count=0 WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS = 0 BEGIN UPDATE #tmpnumery --podliczanie ilosci mozliwych sciezek jako sumy ilosci na elementach prowadzacych do elementu SET C=(SELECT SUM(C) FROM #tmpnumery WHERE GN IN (SELECT TWG_GIDNumer FROM CDN.TwrGrupy WHERE TWG_GRONumer=@n AND TWG_GIDTyp=-16 AND TWG_GIDNumer > 0)) WHERE GN=@n SET @prevcount=@count SET @count=(SELECT SUM(C) FROM #tmpnumery) FETCH NEXT FROM c INTO @n END CLOSE c DEALLOCATE c END SELECT * FROM #tmpnumery END
